description: Freelance agreement, independent contractor agreement, or services agreement

clauses.name: Scope of Work
clauses.description: What services the freelancer/contractor will provide

high: Scope is vague or open-ended ('any tasks as assigned')
low: Clear, specific deliverables with defined acceptance criteria

clauses.name: Compensation and Payment Terms
clauses.description: How much, when, and how the freelancer gets paid

high: Payment contingent on subjective client satisfaction
Payment only after full project completion with no milestones
low: Clear rates, milestone-based payments, net-30 or better, late payment provisions

clauses.name: Intellectual Property Ownership
clauses.description: Who owns the work product created under the agreement

high: All IP transfers to client including tools, templates, and pre-existing work
medium: Work product transfers but freelancer retains right to use for portfolio
low: Clear IP assignment of deliverables only, with pre-existing IP carve-out and portfolio rights

medium: Broad but with standard exclusions and reasonable duration
low: Clearly scoped with standard exclusions and limited duration

clauses.name: Termination
clauses.description: How either party can end the engagement

high: Client can terminate without payment for completed work
No kill fee or wind-down provisions
medium: Termination allowed with short notice but payment for completed work
low: Balanced termination with reasonable notice, payment for completed work, and kill fee

clauses.name: Liability and Indemnification
clauses.description: Limits on liability and indemnification obligations

high: Must indemnify for client's own negligence
medium: Standard mutual indemnification with liability cap at fees paid
low: Reasonable liability cap, mutual indemnification limited to breach

clauses.name: Independent Contractor Status
clauses.description: Confirmation that freelancer is not an employee

high: No independent contractor clause at all
Terms resemble employment (set hours, exclusive engagement, provided equipment)
medium: Independent contractor stated but some terms may blur the line
low: Clear independent contractor language consistent with actual working arrangement

clauses.name: Insurance Requirements
clauses.description: Whether the freelancer must carry specific insurance

high: Excessive insurance requirements disproportionate to the engagement

clauses.name: Governing Law
clauses.description: Which jurisdiction's laws govern the agreement

high: Governing law in a distant or unfamiliar jurisdiction
low: Governing law in a mutually convenient jurisdiction
